about: An open source password manager for individuals and teams.

prs.title: Exporting a backup no longer removes attachments
prs.broken: Exporting an encrypted backup removed every attachment from the vault in the app, and the next edit saved the vault without them, so the files were lost from their items.
prs.changed: The export now works on copies, so only the exported file leaves attachments out.
prs.matters: People can back up their vault without losing the files attached to their passwords.
